Today we observe Korean War Veterans Armistice Day.

For too long, Korea was called the Forgotten War. The men and women who served there were overlooked, their service undersold, and their sacrifices under-recognized.

More than 36,000 Americans gave their lives during the Korean War. Those who returned home carried the memories and sacrifices of the conflict with them for the rest of their lives.

They are not forgotten here. Not now. Not ever.

To every Korean War veteran, we stand with you.
